nodes.norm_label: adr 0001: replace mui joy with tailwind + shadcn/ui
nodes.rationale: Joy UI is beta and deprioritized by MUI; its bespoke theme layer is friction. Owning shadcn component source removes a runtime design-system dependency at the cost of maintaining components.

nodes.norm_label: adr 0002: supabase as the sole auth strategy
nodes.rationale: Five auth strategies bloated deps and flows though real projects use one; Supabase only, keeping the AuthStrategy enum so another provider can be added later.

nodes.label: ADR 0003: Mock-first typed Service Seam
nodes.rationale: App must run with zero backend yet make going real a one-file change per service; screens never read mock data directly.

nodes.label: ADR 0004: RSC + Server Actions as default data pattern
nodes.norm_label: adr 0004: rsc + server actions as default data pattern
nodes.rationale: One default so every contributor writes screens the same way; minimal client bundle, no client query library by default.

nodes.label: ADR 0005: Multi-tenancy with organizations, memberships and RLS (superseded)
nodes.norm_label: adr 0005: multi-tenancy with organizations, memberships and rls (superseded)

nodes.label: ADR 0006: Drizzle as the typed data layer behind the seam
nodes.norm_label: adr 0006: drizzle as the typed data layer behind the seam
nodes.rationale: Typed queries and migrations behind unchanged seam signatures, mock-by-default, no DB connection at import/build time; prepare:false for the Supabase transaction pooler.

nodes.norm_label: adr 0007: posthog analytics, opt-in, reverse-proxied, privacy-first
nodes.rationale: Analytics must be inert without a key, must not weaken the nonce CSP; same-origin /relay proxy keeps CSP unchanged and dodges ad-blockers.

nodes.label: ADR 0009: Cookieless anonymous Website analytics, no consent banner
nodes.norm_label: adr 0009: cookieless anonymous website analytics, no consent banner
nodes.rationale: Anonymous cookieless data is not personal information under the Data Privacy Act of 2012; a banner would lose 30-60% of visitors for no compliance gain.
